title: Nutty Australian Cashews Stew
description: A wine-infused, chewy stew that pairs leftover roast with creamy cashews for a quick weeknight dinner.
instructions: Heat a large pot over medium heat and add a splash of olive oil.
Sauté the diced onion and minced garlic until fragrant and translucent, about 3 minutes.
Stir in the sliced carrot and cook for another 2 minutes.
Pour in the red wine, letting it reduce by half, then add the tomato paste and stir until fully incorporated.
Add the shredded leftover roasted chicken, vegetable broth, dried thyme, salt, and pepper, bringing the mixture to a gentle simmer.
Let the stew simmer uncovered for 15 minutes, allowing the flavors to meld.
While the stew simmers, toast the cashews in a dry skillet until lightly browned, about 4 minutes.
Stir the toasted cashews into the stew during the last 5 minutes of cooking, ensuring they absorb some liquid.
Taste and adjust seasoning if needed, adding more salt or pepper.
Serve hot over a bed of cooked quinoa or crusty bread.
